sources.title: SNEDAI live list of countries exempt from Côte d’Ivoire entry visas
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, State-recognised Côte d’Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live SNEDAI visa page actively embeds this list in its visa-exemption popup and identifies SNEDAI as the only visa-request site recognised and approved by the State of Côte d’Ivoire.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les nationaux des pays ci-dessus, détenteurs de passeport ordinaire ou officiel ne sont pas soumis à l’obligation de visa.

sources.title: SNEDAI current online pre-enrolment and Abidjan airport issuance procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, State-recognised Côte d’Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live State-recognised service describes ordinary-passport scope, pre-enrolment, authority approval and biometric printing and delivery at Abidjan airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa est imprimé et délivré immédiatement.

sources.title: Côte d’Ivoire Ministry of Foreign Affairs current traveller entry guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Côte d’Ivoire
sources.officialityEvidence: The live 2026 Ministry page directs travellers to SNEDAI while preserving visa-at-airport treatment as conditional rather than universal.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passeport valide plus de 6 mois et visa requis, demande en ligne via Snedai ou visa aéroportuaire sous conditions.

sources.title: Côte d’Ivoire Embassy in Italy reference to the four-group visa framework

sources.officialityEvidence: The currently live official mission page identifies the 1993 order and circulars behind nationality groups but does not expose the referenced annex.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les textes classifient les pays en quatre groupes A, B, C et D.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: Côte d’Ivoire visa exemption
policies.summary: SNEDAI’s live entry-visa exemption list directly names Singapore, Morocco, Tunisia, the Philippines, Chad, the Republic of the Congo and the Central African Republic and expressly includes ordinary passports. Their short-visitor baseline is visa-free, not an electronic or airport-issued visa.
conditions: The published list states the visa exemption but does not state a stay duration or a separate effective date.
Passport validity, health, security, entry-point and individual-admissibility controls remain separate from the visa exemption.
The list also covers official passports, but this policy normalizes only the ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline.
The live page embeds an asset uploaded in May 2024 and publishes no end date; recheck the active list when SNEDAI or the Ministry replaces it.
